left.raw_text: Prior receipt of investigational anti-HIV vaccine
Ongoing therapy with any of the following: Systemic corticosteroids
Short course less than or equal to 21 days of corticosteroids is allowed; Systemic chemotherapeutic agents
Nephrotoxic systemic agents, including aminoglycosides, amphotericin B, cidofovir, cisplatin, foscarnet, pentamidine

right.raw_text: Immunomodulatory treatments including Interleukin-2; Investigational agents

left.raw_text: Known allergy/sensitivity or any hypersensitivity to components of study drugs (ART) or their formulations
Active drug or alcohol use or dependence that would interfere with adherence to study requirements
Serious medical or psychiatric illness that would interfere with the ability to adhere to study requirements
Chronic or acute hepatitis B infection

right.raw_text: Use of female hormonal products based on estrogen or derivatives
